groups.name: Finite correction residual
groups.scope: Six noncommuting finite operator matrices and six truncation depths; exact right residual signs and ordering.

groups.name: Exact factorization and two-sided inverse
groups.scope: Six finite models test N=C N0 and both ordered inverse identities; no symbol-class assertion follows from a finite matrix.

groups.name: Reflection cancellation
groups.scope: Six noncommuting finite operator models test the full identity eliminating the apparent one-third loss.

groups.name: Complete polynomial composition
groups.scope: Four Gaussian-matrix inputs test the terminating degree-two composition, all derivative terms and D=-i partial.

groups.name: Adjoint correction sign
groups.scope: Four matrix Gaussian tests verify D composed with the conjugate coefficient equals its full left-symbol expansion.

groups.name: Exact Airy derivative at the transition
groups.scope: The Riccati identity gives partial_mu h=-i/lambda, excluding ordinary order-minus-two-thirds membership.

groups.name: Gaussian commutator-kernel samples
groups.scope: Forty-one Airy samples at lambda=16 illustrate the normalized Fourier-kernel factor; they do not prove the symbol calculus.
